pages.title: The Curious Corner
pages.text: Try functional curiosities in decor; sacks and a side table furnish your own small shop corner.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The register is decorative storage, not currency processing. A normal Copper Light is controllable; the shoddy one flickers. Sacks and pots can form decorative stacks.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place the Vintage Cash Register and use its storage. Store items inside this decorative register; no currency-processing rule is inferred.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the Copper Light's on/off interaction. Change its illumination state; the shoddy variant instead flickers randomly.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place the mod's stackable sacks, ceramic pots, wrapped meat or kitchenware. Build up compact decorative arrangements.
